start.title: [TODO:ru] A Prophet at the Door
start.text:
[TODO:ru] Jeremiah stands before your throne.
He says Babylon is the Lord's rod.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You silence the voice, not the truth.
[TODO:ru] Hard words can save a kingdom.
[TODO:ru] Pride closes the only open door.

imprison_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Chains Cannot Bind Truth
imprison_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The cistern is deep, but his words remain.
The Lord still speaks through him.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You call for him in secret.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Silence Is Not Safety
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The throne grows colder when prophets are sent away.
His warning still rings in your ears.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You bring him back to speak.

preach.title: [TODO:ru] The Streets of Jerusalem
preach.text:
[TODO:ru] Jeremiah cries out in the square.
"Turn back, or this city will fall."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Soften his message for the people
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] A watered prophecy saves no one.
[TODO:ru] Hiding the warning hides the way out.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Let him speak the full word
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You let the truth be heard.

soften_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Half a Word
soften_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] A muffled prophecy is no prophecy.
The Lord asked for the whole truth.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Let him speak the full word
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You step back and let him preach.

retreat_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] The Square Is Quiet
retreat_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Without his voice, the city hears nothing.
Only its own pride.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Let him speak the full word
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You return him to the steps.

reject.title: [TODO:ru] Folded Arms, Closed Hearts
reject.text:
[TODO:ru] The citizens mock the prophet.
"Peace, peace," they cry.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The Lord did not send you to curse.
[TODO:ru] You refuse to join the laughter.
[TODO:ru] Mocking the prophet mocks the Lord.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Not Yours to Judge
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Anger is not the answer the Lord asks of you.
Only faithful witness.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You quiet your tongue.

giveup_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Turn from the Crowd
giveup_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Their laughter will not save the walls.
Only the word will.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You leave the mocking circle.

siege.title: [TODO:ru] Babylon at the Gates
siege.text:
[TODO:ru] Nebuchadnezzar's army surrounds the walls.
The prophet says: do not resist.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Trust the idols on the high places
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Wood and stone cannot lift a siege.
[TODO:ru] Egypt is a broken reed.
[TODO:ru] Submission to God outweighs strength.

idols_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Silent Stones
idols_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The idols cannot answer the rams at the gate.
The Lord alone speaks.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You turn from the high places.

egypt_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] A Broken Reed
egypt_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Egypt's army falters and turns home.
Only the Lord's word remains.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You set down the false hope.

famine.title: [TODO:ru] Bread Is Gone
famine.text:
[TODO:ru] Inside the walls, the children grow thin.
Jeremiah weeps in the empty streets.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Blame the prophet for the hunger
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Blame will not feed your people.
[TODO:ru] You cannot outrun the Lord's word.
[TODO:ru] Late repentance is still repentance.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] He Only Spoke
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The prophet did not bring the army.
Your ears refused his words.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You bow your head at last.

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] No Hidden Path
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Every road is watched, every gate is closed.
Only the Lord can be sought now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You turn from the back gate.

fall.title: [TODO:ru] The Walls Are Breached
fall.text:
[TODO:ru] Fire climbs the temple stones.
Smoke covers the holy hill.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The walls cannot shelter you now.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Try to escape the broken wall
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The plain of Jericho will catch you.
[TODO:ru] You bow beneath the rod He warned of.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Stones Will Fall
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The temple will not be a fortress.
Its hour has come.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You step into the open.

escape_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Caught at Jericho
escape_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The Babylonians ride faster than your fear.
There is nowhere left to run.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You let the chariots take you.

exile.title: [TODO:ru] The Long Road East
exile.text:
[TODO:ru] Jerusalem falls behind in smoke.
The people walk the road to Babylon.
